name: Abercrombie's Crate
summary: Near the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound, Abercrombie's Crate waits for its owner. Ogres drove him off while he gathered herbs, leaving his delicate tools behind.

sections.title: Lost to the Ogres
sections.body: Abercrombie left his shack in western Duskwood to gather plants. Far from home, he met a hostile band of ogres and fled for his life. He left his crate of instruments and gathered plants behind. The ogres carried it to the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound, where the heavy chest rests near the cave mouth.

sections.title: Peculiar Contents
sections.body: Abercrombie calls the tools and plants in his crate harmless. Yet when the crate is returned, his excitement gives him away. He nearly thanks the “Nec-” before catching himself. The purpose of his stolen tools remains in doubt.

faq.answer: The crate lies outdoors beside the cave mouth at the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound, in the southern hills of Duskwood.
Abercrombie was gathering herbs far from his home when ogres attacked him. He fled on foot, leaving his supplies behind. The ogres carried them to their lair.
Abercrombie says the crate holds rare herbs and specialized harvesting tools. His excitement and slip of the tongue when it is returned suggest the tools may serve a darker purpose.

faq.q: Why does Abercrombie almost thank 'the Nec-'?
faq.answer: When Abercrombie gets his crate back, he blurts out, “Thank the Nec-...” then corrects himself and thanks the adventurer. He never says who or what he almost thanked.

angles.text: Abercrombie ventures deep into the forest for rare plants. Recovering his botanist's kit is familiar work for a local herbalist.
You venture into the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound to retrieve lost goods. Ogres threaten southern Duskwood.
